ink.title: 墨
ink.overview: 讲述出版商鲁珀特·默多克收购英国日报《太阳报》的故事：他将报纸交给行事不择手段的拉里·兰姆经营，后者以竞争对手《镜报》为代价，把《太阳报》打造成英国销量最高的小报

bucking-fastard.title: 魂淡
bucking-fastard.overview: 一对形影不离的双胞胎姐妹“琼”和“珍”在社会边缘挣扎求生的故事。影片灵感源自英国同卵双胞胎弗雷达与格里塔·卓别林——这对姐妹在1980年代初期因疯狂迷恋隔壁的卡车司机邻居而登上小报头条，最终对方对她们申请了限制令。卓别林姐妹是已知唯一能同步说话的双胞胎，片名正源于她们在法庭上同时发生的口误。

wild-horse-nine.title: 野马九号
wild-horse-nine.overview: 1973年智利，性格迥异的CIA特工克里斯和李被局长从圣地亚哥派往复活节岛，这对搭档将执行一项考验彼此信任和忠诚的任务。

fjord.title: 峡湾
fjord.overview: 故事聚焦于格奥尔基一家，讲述这家人从罗马尼亚搬迁至挪威一座偏远小村庄后，本与邻居相处融洽，却意外陷入一桩令人不安的指控。随着调查深入，他们不仅要面对小镇居民的监视与敌意，生活也从此失序，坠入混乱的泥沼。

los-domingos.title: 礼拜天
los-domingos.overview: 一位年轻、才华横溢且充满理想的17岁少女艾娜拉，她正面临着大学选修专业的抉择。至少，她的家人是这么希望的。然而，艾娜拉却透露，她感到自己与上帝的联系日益紧密，并且她准备成为一名隐修女。这个惊人的消息让全家人都措手不及，引发了家庭的分裂，也成为了对他们所有人的一次严峻考验。

look-back.title: 蓦然回首
look-back.overview: 电影将细腻描绘藤野与京本从小学一路走过的13年，更以藤本树的家乡——秋田县仁贺保市为中心拍摄，让作品浸润在最纯粹的光影里，饱览陪伴主角成长的四季风景。

possible-love.title: 假如爱有如果
possible-love.overview: 在这个故事中，两对已婚夫妇——失业工人和妻子与纪录片制作人和丈夫——因拍摄纪录片而相遇，各自面对不同的人生和隐藏的欲望。

hope-na.title: 希望
hope-na.overview: 20世纪70至80年代，生活在非军事区附近孤立村庄——湖浦港的居民，与不明外星生物对抗。

yellow-letters.title: 告知信
yellow-letters.overview: 安卡拉艺术家夫妇德丽娅与阿齐兹因政治压力失去工作和住所，被迫带着13岁女儿搬到伊斯坦布尔亲属家中，在生计、理想与家庭关系之间重新寻找位置。

two-seasons-two-strangers.title: 旅途中的日子
two-seasons-two-strangers.overview: 改编自柘植义春的漫画《海边的抒景》《混沌洞的笨先生》，讲述郁郁不得志的李编剧因缘际会来到一个大雪纷飞的深山中，误打误撞进入了一家破旧的旅馆。屋顶几乎被积雪压塌，旅馆的老板笨造看起来毫无干劲，旅馆里没有暖气，饭菜也马马虎虎，连床铺都得自己铺。然而，笨造似乎藏着什么秘密。某天晚上，笨造带着李踏入了夜晚雪原……

palestine-36.title: 巴勒斯坦36号
palestine-36.overview: 尤瑟夫每天都往返于他的农耕村庄巴斯玛和他在耶路撒冷城里的工作之间，满怀热情地努力在瞬息万变的现代世界中寻找自己的位置。他年轻而躁动，更渴望摆脱乡村生活的束缚，而不是被卷入其中的种种烦恼。尤瑟夫的故事与年轻寡妇拉巴布和她的女儿阿芙拉、粗犷的领袖哈立德、鞋匠兼当地神父卡里姆的儿子以及活力四射的都市人胡卢德和她的商人丈夫阿明的故事交织在一起。

all-of-a-sudden.title: 突如其来
all-of-a-sudden.overview: 玛丽-露是一家位于巴黎郊区的养老院（EHPAD）负责人，尽管面临重重阻力，她仍努力在院内推行一种创新而充满人文关怀的护理方式。一次意外的相遇改变了她的人生轨迹——她结识了身患癌症的日本导演麻里。两位女性因共同的价值观，以及彼此对对方语言的深切眷恋而走到一起，展开了一段深厚的友谊，这段关系不仅改变了她们对生命的看法，也悄然改变了整个养老机构。

the-odyssey.title: 奥德赛
the-odyssey.overview: 特洛伊战争之后，奥德修斯踏上返回伊萨卡的艰险归途，途中遭遇了诸如独眼巨人波吕斐摩斯、塞壬女妖和喀耳刻等神话生物。

digger.title: 挖掘者
digger.overview: 世界上最有权势的男子极力证明自己其实是人类的救世主，结果等来了他酝酿的灾难要摧毁万物。

gloaming-in-luomu.title: 罗目的黄昏
gloaming-in-luomu.overview: 小白收到一封来自西南小镇寄出的明信片，是三年前不辞而别的男友发来的。犹豫再三，她决定去往小镇探个究竟。

black-red-yellow.title: 黑，红，黄
black-red-yellow.overview: 吉尔吉斯斯坦的群山中，图尔杜古尔是手艺最好的地毯织工，她的作品不仅织出图案，更织出人们的命运。一条黑，一条红，一条黄，三条地毯映照出三种性格与人生轨迹：黑色代表沉静与厚重，红色象征热烈与冲动，黄色则带有回忆与哀愁的色彩。通过一条未完成的地毯，一段匆匆告别的感情徐徐展开。生活中细腻而真实的情感，和家庭中的责任，在这里静静交织。这不仅是一则爱情故事，更是一部关于传统、性格与命运如何交织成一体的温情之作。

the-dreamed-adventure.title: 向往的冒险
the-dreamed-adventure.overview: 一个生活在保加利亚、希腊和土耳其边境地区的女子，为了帮助朋友，同意参与一项特殊交易。然而，这将使她陷入危险境地，她也将不得不面对自己的欲望。

the-black-ball.title: 黑球
the-black-ball.overview: 三个同性恋男子在西班牙历史上1932 年、1937 年和 2017 年三个不同时期的故事。

coward.title: 懦夫
coward.overview: 青年士兵皮埃尔渴望在第一次世界大战的战场上证明自己。在前线后方，他遇到了弗朗西斯，后者正被要求想办法提振士气。

busan-jury-2026-zhang-yimou.title: 大红灯笼高高挂
busan-jury-2026-zhang-yimou.overview: 改编自苏童小说《妻妾成群》。大学刚读半年的颂莲（巩俐）被贪钱的母亲逼迫着嫁进陈家大院，成了老爷的第四房姨太。陈府有老规矩，姨太太们傍晚时分要站在自已的屋子前，等待下人送来的意味被老爷“临幸”的大红灯笼。

tender-loving-care.title: Tender Loving Care
tender-loving-care.overview: Amy is a devoted social service worker who puts her heart and soul into her job to care for those in need. At home, however, she finds herself confronting new challenges as her beloved father begins to show the early signs of dementia, and she and her mother must begin to make peace with their new reality. Through it all, Amy finds comfort, perspective, and plenty of laughter through sips of wine with her lifelong friend Rosie, whose warmth and wit become a vital anchor as both women navigate the shifting rhythms of approaching middle age.

ghost-song.title: Ghost Song
ghost-song.overview: After her death, 17-year-old Aisha finds her way into Elias' dreams from the afterlife and a passionate romance begins in which the boundaries between dream and reality become blurred.

glimmer-girl.title: Glitter for Girls
glimmer-girl.overview: Glitter for Girls is a handmade tattoo film that utilizes a cameraless direct-on-film animation approach to craft a collage composed of multiple layers of water tattoos (commonly used by children).

woman-unknown.title: 女人，未知
woman-unknown.overview: Marie, a former housekeeper, plans an extravagant dinner party for her engagement to the household's patriarch. As preparations unfold, hidden aspects of her past begin to surface, threatening to disrupt the celebration.

naza.title: 唯一的家园
naza.overview: 来自约旦河西岸马萨费尔亚塔的年轻巴勒斯坦活动家巴塞尔·阿德拉，自幼便为反抗以色列占领军对其社群的大规模驱逐而抗争。他持续记录家乡村落遭蚕食消亡的过程：以色列政府派遣的士兵逐步拆毁房屋，驱离居民。某个时刻，他结识了以色列记者尤瓦尔，后者支持他的抗争行动。一段看似不可能的同盟由此建立。但两人关系因彼此处境的巨大不平等而日益紧张：巴塞尔生活在军事占领下，尤瓦尔却享有自由无拘的生活。这部由四位年轻活动家组成的巴以集体创作的电影，是一次在追寻更大程度公正道路上的创作性抵抗。[柏林电影节]

honorary-yeoh.title: 瞬息全宇宙
honorary-yeoh.overview: 焦头烂额的移民母亲伊芙琳·王突然接到来自平行宇宙的联络，被告知唯有她能拯救世界。这位看似普通的英雄必须学着掌控自己新获得的力量，在支离破碎的多元宇宙时间线中奋力抗争，以拯救她的家园、家人，以及那个迷失在琐碎生活中的自己。

busan-31-cuaron.title: 罗马
busan-31-cuaron.overview: 在其第八部、也是最私人化的作品中，阿方索·卡隆重现了他童年时代1970年代初的墨西哥城，通过原住民帮佣克莱奥（雅利扎·阿帕里西奥 饰，以其启示性的银幕首秀）的视角，讲述了一个中产阶级家庭动荡时期的生活。克莱奥负责照看四个遭父亲遗弃的幼童，在个人生活亦被政局与情感波澜所撼动之际，仍悉心维系着这个家庭。卡隆集编剧、导演、摄影及联合剪辑于一身，本片是电影史上鲜有匹敌的呕心沥血之作，运用纪念碑式的黑白摄影、沉浸式声效，以及专业与非专业演员的混搭，将作者的记忆雕琢成一个质感丰盈的世界，以此致敬那位抚育他成长的女性。[标准收藏]

nowhere-to-lay-eyes.title: 无处安放我的双眼
nowhere-to-lay-eyes.overview: 尚熙与弟弟一起前往济州岛探望母亲，这是她时隔十年的首次造访。母亲经营的餐馆获得了巨大成功。继父正在拍摄一部关于“草坟”的电影，他的女儿最近开始画画。一些此前从未为人所知的事实逐渐浮现，以及那些并无必要的忠告。

goodbye-ufo.title: 再见UFO
goodbye-ufo.overview: 1985年，香港仔华富邨曾经有UFO低空飞过的都市传说，轰动一时。三个少年陈子健、何家谦、林可儿是当年的目击者，随着各人成长，性格迥异的三人都有着不同的人生轨迹。这时香港正经历天翻地覆的改变，80年代的希望，90年代的浮躁，都落于千禧的苍白里。当三个成长伙伴再聚首，早已认不出自己，也早已认不出香港。受尽冲击的他们不禁问，当年在天台看见的神秘光芒，到底是什么？

nina-roza.title: Nino – A Film About Nino Rota
nina-roza.overview: An in-depth documentary into the life of renowned Italian composer Nino Rota, who wrote the score for 16 films directed by Federico Fellini, including “La Strada,” “8 1/2,” “Juliet of the Spirits” and “Amarcord,” besides “La Dolce Vita.” He also composed music for Franco Zeffirelli’s “Romeo and Juliet” and the Sicilian-inspired theme for “The Godfather,” whose “Part II” score won him his only Oscar. Rota’s 150 films also included collaborations with King Vidor (“War and Peace”) and Luchino Visconti (“The Leopard”). Rota died at 68 in 1979.

dau.title: 列夫·朗道：娜塔莎
dau.overview: 1950年代，娜塔莎在苏联一家秘密的研究所内经营食堂，这里汇集了研究所的员工、科学家和外国访客。 娜塔莎的世界很小，她白天在食堂干活，晚上和年轻同事奥利亚一起喝酒，倾诉对浪漫的渴求和对未来的幻想。 在一次聚会之夜，娜塔莎与来访的法国科学家卢克·比格变得亲密起来。 第二天，当克格勃的弗拉基米尔·阿奇波将军对她进行讯问时，她的生活发生了戏剧性的转变。

good-little-soldier.title: A Good Little Soldier
good-little-soldier.overview: Follows Carla, a 43-year-old high-performing executive newly recruited as HR manager of a major insurer, tasked with rebuilding its brand in a corporate environment where vulnerability is not an asset.

fire-inside.title: The Fire Within You
fire-inside.overview: Antonio, who fled Naples many years ago, has built a family and a successful career in Milan, far from his mother Angela — a woman excessive in both her virtues and her flaws, irresistible, old-fashioned and hostile like few others — who has come to visit for Christmas and seems determined to stay.  Christmas Eve dinner becomes an emotional battlefield, at once comic and fierce, bringing to the surface a past of impositions and misunderstandings. With a stubborn capon that refuses to end up in the pot, a daughter whose arrival remains uncertain, and an unexpected distinguished guest, the evening turns into a reckoning between mother and son destined to change the meaning of their bond forever: a love that burns like a fire within, one that never dies out — not even by leaving.

tonight-will-happen.title: It will happen tonight
tonight-will-happen.overview: In Oslo, Thea and Matteo are awaiting the birth of their child. Meanwhile, in Mumbai, Charles asks Greta to marry him in public. Seven years later, in Rome, Matteo is playing tennis when Greta shows up for a match, dressed as a bride. For him it's love at first sight, but she's just married. Life goes on, yet Matteo cannot forget Greta. Seven years later, they meet again by chance; both are married and have children with other people. Love always brings them together at the wrong time. Loosely based on the short story collection "Legami" by Eshkol Nevo.

halima.title: I Should've Been There
halima.overview: Divorcee Clint struggles to reconnect with his estranged daughter, Toni, during his first day of custody.

falling-house.title: Falling House
falling-house.overview: A modest family on the outskirts of Tehran faces the imminent destruction of their home as a part of a vast redevelopment project. While Rashid, the father and a prison guard, is being accused of corruption, he discovers that his eldest daughter, Ensi, is secretly planning to leave Iran to become a model. As the bulldozers draw ever closer, the tensions within the household start to rise.

children-of-the-monkey.title: Children of the Monkey
children-of-the-monkey.overview: Dario, father of a disabled child, begins to receive attention from his brother's teenage son, discovering that he prefers him to his own. In the growing complicity with his nephew he finds the son he would have liked to have, he takes on the role of the father he could have been. An illusory and dangerous role-playing game that will put the entire family at risk.

i-matter.title: I Matter
i-matter.overview: As she stands on the verge of leaving the orphanage she called home, Rebeca, a young Roma girl, clings to the hope that her father's release from prison will finally give her the family she has always longed for. When she is accepted into university to study acting, life finally seems to be opening up for her. But just as Rebeca begins to find her place in this new world, the life she comes from starts to catch up with her, forcing her to make choices she can no longer postpone.

jo-phaedra.title: A Day in the Life of Jo: Chapter Phaedra
jo-phaedra.overview: Jo, a 15-year-old tomboy, has a nightmare made of fog and aurora light: her dog is lost, her voice cannot be heard, and her surroundings seem completely unfamiliar. Has the tone of the day been set yet?

sheep-in-the-box.title: 盒子里的羊
sheep-in-the-box.overview: 影片片名灵感来源于《小王子》。在近未来的日本社会中，中小型建筑公司总裁（大悟 饰）与同为建筑师的妻子（绫濑遥 饰）在痛失爱子后，竟不惜代价借助AI复活技术重建家庭，家中迎来了外貌与声音跟儿子一模一样的人形仿生机器人，更一起重启生活日常，但一个意外事故牵引著每一位家庭成员直面心底隐藏的情感，走向他们意想不到的疗愈之旅。

bitter-christmas.title: 苦涩的圣诞节
bitter-christmas.overview: 广告总监埃尔莎在母亲于12月去世后，用工作麻痹自己以应对伤痛。一次惊恐发作迫使她停下脚步，她决定与好友帕特里夏前往兰萨罗特岛旅行。两位女性的故事与一位编剧兼电影导演的经历平行展开，探讨了生活与虚构如何密不可分地交织，有时甚至令人痛苦地纠缠。

parallel-tales.title: 平行故事
parallel-tales.overview: 为了给新小说寻找灵感，西尔维偷窥起对面的邻居。她雇了年轻的亚当来帮自己处理日常生活，却没想到这个年轻人将彻底改变她的生活与创作，直到她所想象的虚构故事超越了所有人的现实。

place-to-heal.title: A Place to Heal
place-to-heal.overview: In a French public hospital, the adolescent psychiatry unit moves to the erratic rhythm of teenagers coming and going - many carrying heavy past baggage - while Etienne and his medical team navigate the relentless cycle of treating, listening, and confronting the raw edges of suffering. Young Lucia knows the ward too well. After being brought back yet again by the police, she reunites with her friend Eloïse and encounters a constellation of young patients, each wrestling with their own storms. At times, there is laughter, small breakthroughs, moments of fragile hope. But the balance is shaky, and the arrival of a new patient will shatter it entirely.

family-matters.title: Family Still Matters
family-matters.overview: When you're down on your luck and there is no one to run too, family is always there to make things work out. Whether you're feuding or fighting, you still make everything alright. That's where the Garrett family stands. Battling life's obstacles and raising children on an average pay schedule will make you become stressed, loaded with agony, balled up with hatred and devious ways, and you lose hope sometimes, but with family by your side you have weight of the world lifted off of you.

fruit-gathering.title: Fruit Gathering
fruit-gathering.overview: In industrial Yangon, young factory worker San Kyi dreams of returning to her native village. Her relationship with co-worker Theint Theint Oo evolves from closeness to growing distance, revealing tensions between their expectations and life prospects. Amid exhausting labour, social repression, and economic uncertainty, both women seek escape and intimacy.

atlantic.title: Atlantic
atlantic.overview: Documentary about the two big resources in the North Atlantic, fish and oil, and the impact of their exploitation on the environment in various countries on both sides of the Atlantic.

queen-at-sea.title: 茫然女王
queen-at-sea.overview: 阿尔茨海默病逐渐剥夺了一位女性表达自我的能力，也严重影响了她与他人的沟通。她的丈夫与女儿竭力为她谋求最大福祉——在爱与关怀、守护与自主之间的脆弱边界中艰难探寻平衡。

everybody-digs-bill-evans.title: 人人都爱比尔·埃文斯
everybody-digs-bill-evans.overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

ketticè.title: 凯蒂切
ketticè.overview: 21 世纪初的巴勒莫，一群少男少女直面青春期的种种困境与际遇。在这座充满活力的西西里城市里，他们逐渐长大，体悟友情、爱情，完成自我探寻。

the-riverbank.title: The Riverbank
the-riverbank.overview: A woman returns to her hometown following the death of her fathers second wife, which leads her to uncover dark family secrets.

house-of-the-wind.title: House of the Wind
house-of-the-wind.overview: Josette (80) lives alone in Yaoundé, Cameroon. All her children have left for the West. She encourages them to build houses in Cameroon, a ploy to bring them back to her. But the unexpected bond she forms with Sarah, a young woman from her neighborhood, shatters everything she has built her life on: her family, her responsibilities, and her hopes.

diane-in-the-loop.title: Diane In The Loop
diane-in-the-loop.overview: Diane desires men as much as she despises them. When she learns that her mother was raped in her youth, the shock is muffled. It’s a surprise—and yet, it explains everything. Diane has only one thing on her mind: avenging her mother. But her mother has only one thing on her mind: finally becoming the woman she should have been. Between the one who wants to remember and the one who wants to forget, everything tightens.

love-like-mine.title: A Love Like Mine
love-like-mine.overview: A short film that follows the journey of Mae, a lesbian, and Delilah, who discovers her attraction to Mae. As they navigate their love, they must confront personal insecurities to determine if their love can withstand the challenges ahead.

the-housewife.title: Waxie Moon in Fallen Jewel
the-housewife.overview: Is inner beauty more important than shopping? Can homosexuals read? Does prostitution solve everything? And who is she wearing? Discover the answers to these and other existential questions in Fallen Jewel - a new motion picture brought to you by the creators of the acclaimed Capitol Hill series. Featuring sensational original soundtrack, fierce fashion, plenty of man-candy and vibrant performances, it's the queer pop-art fantasia you've been waiting for your whole life. Waxie Moon, a "burlesque performer for a new century" - NPR, searches for a perfect man between exuberant musical numbers and the unspeakable ordeals of motherhood. Addicted to romance and dressed to kill, Waxie is always ready to fall in love. In the wildly shifting world where genders and genres are fluid, Waxie's adventures include a trip to the underworld, a forbidden love affair in the 1950's, and even online dating!

the-guest-kv.title: 不速之客
the-guest-kv.overview: 一位退役归来的士兵与刚在战场上痛失长子的一家人结为朋友，相通的经历让他们的感情维系日益增强，士兵成为了这家人的贵客。然而这家人很快发现，士兵的真实身份并不像他所说的那样……

nagi-notes.title: 奈义日记
nagi-notes.overview: 失落的雕塑家寄子独自在自然丰饶的凪町继续创作生活。某日，在东京与台湾作为建筑师活跃的友梨为担任雕塑模特，请假数日前来拜访寄子。寄子的青梅竹马、早年丧妻的好浩，好浩的儿子春树及其挚友圭太——与这些人的相遇为平静日常带来细微涟漪，那些各自回避的过去与内心逐渐浮现。

paper-tiger.title: 纸老虎
paper-tiger.overview: 聚焦一对在追求“美国梦”过程中深陷泥潭的兄弟。原本看似美好的致富契机，却是一场精心策划的骗局。随着局势失控，两人不仅要应对充斥着腐败与暴力的危险世界，更要面对来自俄罗斯黑帮的残酷威胁。在极端考验下，曾经牢不可破的兄弟情谊开始崩塌，背叛也变得近在咫尺。

one-battle.title: 一战再战
one-battle.overview: 曾经投身激进运动的鲍勃如今早已远离过去，与女儿薇拉过着与世隔绝的生活。十六年来，他始终无法摆脱对危险的警惕，而薇拉也在父亲过度保护下逐渐长大。直到某一天，鲍勃昔日的宿敌突然重新出现，薇拉随之失踪。为了找回女儿，这个早已落魄的前革命者不得不重新联系昔日伙伴，再次踏入那个他竭力逃离多年的世界，而十六年前留下的恩怨也随之重新浮出水面……
